PROP-57888860-asm-003.text: Engine API blob data is semi-trusted; blobs from EL must still pass KZG commitment verification.
PROP-57888860-asm-003.assertion: forall blob from EL: verify_blob_kzg_proof(blob, commitment) == true before propagation

locations.note: engine_newPayloadV3/V4/V5 validation rejects payloads when blob_versioned_hashes from Engine API do not match the flattened transaction blob hashes (FlattenedHashesEqual), preventing mismatch between declared hashes and provided blobs.
Mempool blob tx validation rechecks blob hashes and KZG proofs via IBlobProofsManager.ValidateHashes/ValidateProofs before accepting blob txs.
